'''Adamant leggings''' are [[Armor#Leggings|leggings]] of the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] tier, made by smithing [[diamond leggings]] with [[adamant alloy]]. Adamant replaces netherite, and its armor carries the [[Doom]] intrinsic.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the diamond item carry over; where both have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
They give {{Value|Adamant Leggings|armor}} armor, {{Value|Adamant Leggings|toughness}} toughness and 10% knockback resistance, the vanilla netherite values, with {{Value|Adamant Leggings|durability}} durability. Each piece also has Protection I and Unbreaking II.

=== Doom ===
The [[Doom]] intrinsic periodically clears Weakness from nearby creatures and deals armor-piercing damage as it does, so it combines with the Weakness from adamant weapons. Each piece strengthens it, and wearing all four adds the Doom [[set bonus]] as well as {{Data/Set bonus|adamant_armour=4}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/timers/divinity/adamant_armour.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===
They can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or {{MCW|Block of Gold|blocks of gold}}. Their tooltip says blocks of diamond or [[adamant scrap]], like the other adamant armor, but adamant scrap does not work on the leggings.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/adamant_leggings.json}}</ref> The pack resets repair costs to zero, so they can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] they melt down into one [[adamant alloy]], returning the alloy but losing the diamonds.

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys them for one [[adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_leggings.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows knockback resistance 1 (real value 0.1).
* The leggings are the only adamant armor repaired with blocks of gold. The developer's design video says adamant "requires diamond blocks, gold blocks, or adamant scrap to repair".<ref>{{Cite video|quote=except for adamant, which requires diamond blocks, gold blocks, or adamant scrap to repair.}}</ref>
